body.prompt: Photoreal industrial-design studio render of one palm-sized camera, 57 x 39 x 33 mm, concept ENTROPY: light reaching a black hole. image[1] = exact block and layout, keep it: SMALL 16 mm lens ring right of centre (a quarter of the width), flash window upper left, shutter and recessed switch on top left over the grip, USB-C and microSD on the right side. Idea SHADOW SPHERE, the black hole is not a hole but a shadow: a matte black low dome bulges 5 mm out of the front, only 26 mm across, with the lens ring sunk at its pole. Engraved latitude rings with tick dashes crowd ever closer toward the lens. A satin light-grey machined collar clamps the dome = photon ring: ribbed grip sections, a smooth flat with red index triangle, a small lever with an oblong slot that locks a printed lens cap. Calm graphite body, precise as a tripod head. image[2] = that collar: ribbed sections, red index, slotted lever. image[3] = black dome with engraved tick scale. image[4] = black sphere in a bright photon ring. Vertical grip grooves front left, frosted flash window, knurled shutter collar, switch in a pocket, light-pipe dots, vents, strap anchor, shadow-gap seam. Rich functional surface detail, printable PLA. One camera centred on pure white, 3/4 front view slightly from above, soft light, sharp. --no text, logos, letters, numbers, screen, hands, strap, extra lenses, big lens barrel, screws
